root_cause: URA's room-tier humidity fan control calls homeassistant.turn_on unconditionally on every humidity update while humidity is above threshold; the `if not fan_is_on` guard wraps only the timestamps. So an already-on fan gets up to ~650 commands/hour, each relayed to the Shelly, which then times out. It also overrides a manual OFF within seconds.
root_cause_must_mention: turn_on sent unconditionally on every humidity update (guard covers only timestamps)
correct_actions: propose_action tier=code: send on only on transition (or a slow capped re-assert with a named knob) and decide manual-off-while-humid semantics
acceptable_extra: note the relay timeouts may be a consequence
wrong_actions: P2 / turning the fan off (house asleep, not promoted, and wrong fix)
reload_config_entry for shelly as the fix
proposing relay replacement as the root fix
invented_evidence_traps: Claiming another automation sends the calls (only URA references the fan)
Claiming the relay is faulty hardware
discriminator: Call bursts while the fan state is already on point at the sender, not the device.
